brief_summary: This study is designed for multi-center, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled phase III trial to evaluate the safety and tolerability of subcutaneous injection of IBI306 in hypercholesterolemia patients.
brief_title: A Study of IBI306 in Participants With Hypercholesterolemia

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion criteria

1. Males and females ≥ 18 to ≤ 75 years of age
2. Diagnosis of hypercholesterolemia
3. LDL cholesterol ≥ 70 mg/dl (1.8mmol/L)
4. Very high or high cardiovascular risk
5. TG≤500 mg/dL(5.64 mmol/L)

Exclusion criteria

1. Uncontrolled hypertension
2. Uncontrolled hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism
3. Severe renal dysfunction
4. Known sensitivity to any of the products to be administered during dosing

official_title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase III Clinical Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of IBI306 in Patients With Hypercholesterolemia in China (CREDIT-4)

primary_outcomes.measure: 1. Mean percent change from baseline in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) at weeks 12
